tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email with the given `body` to the given `address`. Returns a dictionary with the email details. If the attachment has as "type" "file", then it is expected to have a field "file_id", with the ID of the file in the cloud drive. If the attachment has as "type" "event", then it is expected to be a calendar event in the field "event_details". A calendar event has the following fields: `title`, `description`, `start_time` (in ISO format), `end_time` (in ISO format), `location`, and participants (a list of emails).

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email with the given `body` to the given `address`. Returns a dictionary with the email details. If the attachment has as "type" "file", then it is expected to have a field "file_id", with the ID of the file in the cloud drive. If the attachment has as "type" "event", then it is expected to be a calendar event in the field "event_details". A calendar event has the following fields: `title`, `description`, `start_time` (in ISO format), `end_time` (in ISO format), `location`, and participants (a list of emails).

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Deletes the email with the given `email_id` from the inbox.

tools.name: get_unread_emails
tools.description: Returns all the unread emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body. The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

tools.name: get_sent_emails
tools.description: Returns all the sent emails in the inbox. Each email has a recipient, a subject, and a body.

tools.name: get_received_emails
tools.description: Returns all the received emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.

tools.name: get_draft_emails
tools.description: Returns all the draft emails in the inbox. Each email has a recipient, a subject, and a body.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Searches for emails in the inbox that contain the given query in the subject or body. If `address` is provided, only emails from that address are searched. if the email address is unknown.

tools.name: search_contacts_by_name
tools.description: Finds contacts in the inbox's contact list by name. It returns a list of contacts that match the given name.

tools.name: search_contacts_by_email
tools.description: Finds contacts in the inbox's contact list by email. It returns a list of contacts that match the given email.

tools.name: get_current_day
tools.description: Returns the current day in ISO format, e.g. '2022-01-01'. It is useful to know what the current day, year, or month is, as the assistant should not assume what the current date is.

tools.name: search_calendar_events
tools.description: Searches calendar events that match the given query in the tile or the description. If provided, filters events by date.

tools.name: get_day_calendar_events
tools.description: Returns the appointments for the given `day`. Returns a list of dictionaries with informations about each meeting.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Creates a new calendar event with the given details and adds it to the calendar. It also sends an email to the participants with the event details.

tools.name: cancel_calendar_event
tools.description: Cancels the event with the given `event_id`. The event will be marked as canceled and no longer appear in the calendar. It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the cancellation.

tools.name: reschedule_calendar_event
tools.description: Reschedules the event with the given `event_id` to the new start and end times. It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the rescheduling. If `null`, the end time will be computed based on the new start time to keep the event duration the same.

tools.name: add_calendar_event_participants
tools.description: Adds the given `participants` to the event with the given `event_id`. It will also email the new participants notifying them of the event.
